description: This file contains implementation of test grains for Orleans reminders, including ReminderTestGrain2, ReminderTestCopyGrain, and related classes, used for testing reminder functionality within Orleans grains.

classes.name: ReminderTestGrain2
classes.description: A test grain implementing reminder registration, handling, and state management for Orleans reminders.

classes.name: ReminderTestCopyGrain
classes.description: A copy of the test grain for reminder testing, with similar functionality adapted for different grain identity.

classes.name: WrongReminderGrain
classes.description: A grain intentionally misconfigured to test incorrect reminder behavior.

classes.name: UnvalidatedReminderRegistry
classes.description: A helper class for managing reminder registration and unregistration with Orleans reminder service.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain activation, initializes state, and retrieves missing reminders.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain deactivation, logs deactivation event.

methods.name: GetReminderStates
methods.description: Returns current state of all reminders.

methods.name: StartReminder
methods.description: Starts a new reminder with specified parameters.

methods.name: ReceiveReminder
methods.description: Handles incoming reminder callbacks, updates internal counters and logs.

methods.name: StopReminder
methods.description: Stops a reminder by name or reference, updates state accordingly.

methods.name: GetMissingReminders
methods.description: Fetches reminders that are registered but not yet tracked locally.

methods.name: GetReminderPeriod
methods.description: Returns the period of a specified reminder.

methods.name: GetReminderDueTimeAndPeriod
methods.description: Returns the due time and period for a reminder.

methods.name: GetCounter
methods.description: Reads the current counter value for a reminder from file.

methods.name: GetReminderObject
methods.description: Retrieves the reminder object for a given reminder name.

methods.name: GetRemindersList
methods.description: Returns a list of all registered reminders.

methods.name: GetFileName
methods.description: Constructs the filename used for storing reminder state.

methods.name: GetDefaultPeriod
methods.description: Provides default reminder period and logs the configuration.

methods.name: EraseReminderTable
methods.description: Clears the reminder table in the Orleans reminder service.
